english.notes:
As from 08/04/2013 Penalty Notices for Disorder may ONLY be issued to offenders aged 18 years or over.

(i) Regulation 5 provides:-
Where a constable has reasonable ground for belief that a person has contravened any one or more of these Regulations, that person shall give on demand his name and address to that constable.
(ii) Regulation 6 provides:-
6(1) The provisions of this regulation shall have effect:-
(a) where an officer, servant or agent of the Secretary of State is acting in the performance of his duty to secure the proper management of a Park or the preservation of order and prevention of abuses therein, or
(b) where a constable or a member of the armed forces or of any fire brigade or ambulance service is acting in the performance of his duty.
(iii) Regulation 6(2) provides:-
Any such person mentioned in paragraph (1) above is for the purpose of regulations 2 and 4 hereby granted permission to do any act mentioned in those regulations.
(iv) This offence may be disposed of by the issue of a Penalty Notice for Disorder as from 30/06/12. The PND code is DB29.
(v) The PND was raised from £50 to £60 as from 01/07/13.
